title: Sports Week 2026 has started
body: Matches run from 20 to 30 October. Check the Matches page for the full schedule and venues.
author: Sports Office

title: Women's cricket trials
body: Departments that still need players can send names to their female sports coordinator before 26 October.
author: Sports Office

title: Football final venue
body: The football final will be played at the Football Ground at 4:00 PM. Spectators should arrive early.
author: Sports Office

title: Prize distribution ceremony
body: The closing ceremony and prize distribution will be held in the main auditorium on 30 October.
author: Sports Office
